title: Education Funding Reform Act
text: This act proposes a 15% increase in state funding for K-12 public schools, with allocations directed toward teacher salaries, classroom technology, and after-school programs. Funding would be distributed based on student enrollment and district need assessments conducted annually by the state education board.

title: Clean Transit Expansion Initiative
text: This initiative authorizes $2.5 billion in bonds to expand electric bus fleets, build new light rail lines, and upgrade existing transit stations for ADA compliance. The measure includes a 0.25% sales tax increase to fund ongoing operations and maintenance over a 20-year period.

title: Affordable Housing Development Program
text: This program establishes a public-private partnership to construct 10,000 new affordable housing units over five years. Developers participating in the program receive expedited permitting and tax credits in exchange for reserving 30% of units for households earning below the area median income.

title: Federal Algorithmic Transparency Act
text: This federal legislation requires social media platforms and tech companies to disclose how their algorithms target content to users under 25. It also provides users the right to opt-out of data tracking for targeted advertising and establishes a federal commission to monitor algorithmic bias.
